glossary.definition:
(1) "Child" means a biological or legally adopted child of a deceased member. If a court hearing for an interlocutory decree for adoption was held prior to the member's death, "child" includes the child who was the subject of the hearing if a final decree of adoption adjudging the member's spouse as the adoptive parent is made subsequent to the member's death.

(2) "Parent" is a parent or legally adoptive parent of a deceased member.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and section 3307.66 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3307.562 - Designation or qualification of beneficiaries.

glossary.definition: (3) "Dependent" means a beneficiary who receives at least one-half of the beneficiary's support from a member during the twelve months prior to the member's death.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and section 3307.66 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3307.562 - Designation or qualification of beneficiaries.

glossary.definition: (4) "Surviving spouse" means an individual who establishes a valid marriage to a member at the time of the member's death by marriage certificate or pursuant to division (E) of this section.
